title: Harvard Library Public and Student Access
snippet: Harvard Square sits adjacent to multiple Harvard libraries and student study spaces, several of which allow visiting-student access.
full_text: Harvard Square is directly adjacent to several Harvard University libraries, including Widener and Lamont, both of which offer extensive study space. A number of cafes and coworking-style spaces in the square are also popular with students from nearby Lesley University and other Cambridge-area schools.
claim_text: Harvard Square offers extensive student-oriented study space, both through adjacent university libraries and nearby cafes.

title: Student Life Guide: Harvard Square
snippet: The square hosts bookstores, student-discount cafes, and a dense concentration of study-friendly spaces.
full_text: Beyond the university libraries, Harvard Square hosts several long-running independent bookstores, a number of cafes offering student discounts, and a dense concentration of study-friendly seating, making it a popular out-of-classroom study destination for students across the Boston area.
claim_text: Harvard Square offers extensive student-oriented study space, both through adjacent university libraries and nearby cafes.
